### Added

- *(workspaces)* Connectivity creates the grant signing key Secret in [#940](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/940) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(substrate)* Follow Substrate 1.8.1, snapshots migrate on the roll in [#943](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/943) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Default workspace-manager's kagent address in [#948](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/948) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(substrate)* Floor Substrate at 1.8.2-rc.5, golden and resume retry in [#949](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/949) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(kagent)* Follow kagent 1.10.0, Sessions set up on workspace volumes in [#951](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/951) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Kagent's session admission from the switch in [#955](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/955) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* A CSI companion for EFS and Azure Files in [#956](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/956) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-manager)* Floor at 1.12.0, start_session with a workspace grant in [#962](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/962) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(klaus-gateway)* Derive workspaces.toolsPrefix while workspaces are on in [#967](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/967) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-manager)* Floor at 1.13.0, start_session without a message in [#968](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/968) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(klaus-gateway)* Floor at 4.3.0, Sessions through start_session in [#971](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/971) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspace-manager)* Floor at 0.5.0 for the gitlab provider kind in [#969](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/969) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update agentgateway line to v2.3.4 in [#937](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/937) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])

### Fixed

- *(connectivity)* Create only the chart's own grant key Secret in [#945](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/945) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(substrate)* 15m HelmRelease timeout, stable 1.8.2 floor in [#953](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/953) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspace-manager)* Floor at 0.4.0, which serves the JWKS in [#954](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/954) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Render the CSI companion's exceptions from the meta chart in [#959](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/959) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* The CSI companion's Envoy as root, a numeric liveness port in [#961](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/961) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(workspaces)* Admit the CSI companion's proxy port on ate-api-server's egress in [#965](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/965) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
